senses.zh_definition: 快子；理论上以超过真空光速的速度运动的假设粒子。
senses.en_definition: A hypothetical particle that travels faster than light in a vacuum.
senses.ms_definition: Zarah hipotesis yang bergerak dengan kelajuan melebihi kelajuan cahaya dalam vakum.
senses.nuances: 物理学及科幻语境中的国际术语；本次未核实 tachyon 为 DBP 认可的马来语词头，因此不标为 official。马来语释义为编写释义，并非 DBP 原文。应保留“假设”的限定。[理论原始论文](https://doi.org/10.1103/PhysRev.159.1089)

dual_scenarios.context: 科学报告 / 科普文章
dual_scenarios.ms: Istilah tachyon dalam laporan ini merujuk kepada zarah hipotesis yang bergerak lebih pantas daripada cahaya dalam vakum.
dual_scenarios.zh: 本报告中的 tachyon 一词指理论上运动速度超过真空光速的假设粒子。
dual_scenarios.en: In this report, the term tachyon refers to a hypothetical particle that travels faster than light in a vacuum.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Aku baru baca pasal tachyon ni, tapi tak berapa faham lah.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Saya baru membaca tentang tachyon ini, tetapi saya kurang memahaminya.
dual_scenarios.zh: 我刚读到快子的介绍，不过还是不太懂啦。
dual_scenarios.en: I just read about tachyons, but I don't really get it.

etymology.historical_story: Physicist Gerald Feinberg coined tachyon in 1967, drawing on Greek takhys, meaning fast. His paper explored how hypothetical particles moving faster than light might fit within relativity. The name gives an unfamiliar theoretical object a memorable identity through speed, but naming a particle does not establish its existence. [Historical study](https://link.springer.com/article/10.1140/epjh/s13129-025-00103-z)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 tachy- 联想到“快”：tachyon 是“比光还快”的假设粒子；这是词义提示，不是马来语构词拆分。
